content: Our intellectual and active powers increase with our affection.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Intellect divorced from love becomes cold and analytical. Passionate care and devotion expand the intellect's capacity to comprehend depth.
practicalInsight: Infuse genuine care into the project or craft you are working on today; love elevates intelligence.
reflectionPrompt: How does your mental clarity change when you work out of deep love rather than cold duty?
